event: emit_pressure_state (live MCP tool) still writes the OLD field name host_headroom_mb to pressure-state.json -- the documented rename to container_vm_headroom_mb (FIX-PRESSURE-HOST-HEADROOM-WRONG-MACHINE-WRONG-QUANTITY, 2026-07-28) has NOT actually been deployed to the tool, only to the flow docs that read it
discovered_during: cowork-team 16:00Z tick, Step 5.1 (spawn-fanout.md headroom-gated batch cap) while computing MAX_PARALLEL for a 4-slot WORK tick

evidence.doc_claim: docs/agents/cowork-team/flow/spawn-fanout.md Step 5.1 and docs/agents/cowork-team/flow/telemetry.md Step 6.0 both state the field was renamed host_headroom_mb -> container_vm_headroom_mb on 2026-07-28, and Step 5.1's pseudocode reads PRESSURE_STATE.container_vm_headroom_mb specifically.
evidence.live_read: jq -c '.' docs/data/pressure-state.json immediately after this tick's own emit_pressure_state call (success:true) returned {"emitted_at":"2026-07-29T15:50:34.132Z",...,"host_headroom_mb":2565,"stale_warning":false} -- key is still host_headroom_mb, container_vm_headroom_mb is absent entirely, both before and after a fresh emit this tick.
evidence.consequence: Step 5.1's predicate 'PRESSURE_STATE.container_vm_headroom_mb is a number' is always false (key does not exist -> undefined, not a number) -> HEADROOM_MB is unconditionally null -> DEGRADED is unconditionally true via the (HEADROOM_MB == null) OR-clause, regardless of actual container memory. MAX_PARALLEL is therefore ALWAYS max_parallel_degraded (2), never max_parallel_default (4), on every multi-slot tick, even when the container has ample headroom.

hypothesis: The doc-authoring pass (FIX-PRESSURE-HOST-HEADROOM-WRONG-MACHINE-WRONG-QUANTITY) updated the flow markdown (spawn-fanout.md, telemetry.md) to reference the new field name, but the corresponding change to the emit_pressure_state tool implementation (apps/mcp-server) was never shipped/deployed -- a doc/code drift, not a runtime bug in the cowork-team dispatcher itself (which correctly reads whatever key the live tool actually emits).
impact_severity: LOW-MED -- purely a throughput/efficiency defect, not a correctness or data-integrity one. Every WORK tick with >2 matched slots is silently capped to batches of 2 instead of the intended 4, extending fan-out wall-clock time (extra inter-batch wait cycles) with no functional harm. First concretely observed this tick (4 slots matched, 2 batches of 2 fired instead of potentially 1 batch of 4).
recommendation: Route to po -> dev-mcp-server: either (a) ship the container_vm_headroom_mb rename into the actual emit_pressure_state implementation to match the docs, or (b) if the rename was deliberately deferred/rolled back, update spawn-fanout.md/telemetry.md Step 5.1/6.0 to read host_headroom_mb again so the doc and the live tool agree. Either fix is a single-field rename, cheap relative to the (minor, non-blocking) throughput cost of leaving it unfixed.
action_taken_by_dispatcher: None beyond flagging -- Step 5.1 correctly fell into its documented degraded/fail-safe branch given the missing field (this is the fail-safe working as designed, not a dispatcher bug), and all 4 slots this tick still spawned successfully across 2 batches. Do NOT action from cowork-team -- observe+report only.
